output.narrative: The click-through rate (CTR) remained relatively stable, moving from a baseline of 0.010937 to 0.010951. While the overall metric showed little net change, regional and category shifts were observed. For instance, country=AR showed a negative impact with an explanatory power of -8.31 and a lift of -371.24, whereas category=social showed a positive impact with an explanatory power of 16.683 and a lift of 173.51. Further drill-down into AR revealed specific concentration within device_model=iPhone 13 (explanatory power 0.581, lift 5.39) and os_version=iOS 16.4 (explanatory power 0.447, lift 4.59). Meanwhile, other segments such as ad_format=rewarded (lift 5.31) and vertical=travel (lift -52.9) were checked and found to have varying degrees of influence.
